CAMERA, CROP and RENDER STYLE only: three-quarter chest-up framing, eye line height and painterly finish on a flat green background; she is a different character, so ignore her face, hair, hood, scarf, bell and the cross-shaped pins and draw Mahmut's own adult male face

prompt:
Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime light-novel visual-novel bust of a single character, portrait 2:3, one image only; reference images are numbered below.
SUBJECT: Mahmut, an adult man aged 28, a tall weathered former sworn palace guard. Dark messy hair, kept short and clumped into thick locks; stubble along the jaw and chin; brown eyes, tired but steady. Natural adult face with grounded proportions and clean unmarked skin. He wears dark worn half-plate repaired in several mismatched styles by village smiths: a dark steel gorget, a breastplate and layered pauldrons with patched plates and mismatched rivets, as in reference image 1. A small Crown Guard star is mounted on the centre of the breastplate; directly above the star is a small empty hammered-out socket, bare roughened plate with nothing mounted in it, where a crown once sat. Over the armour hangs a tattered oxblood cloak, Guard red dyed darker into a deep brownish crimson, its edges torn in bold ragged shapes. No helmet, no raised hood. Expression: composed, level steady eyes, relaxed jaw, closed mouth, quiet weariness, neutral and calm.
COMPOSITION: three-quarter view, the face turned toward the left side of the frame and the shoulders turned a little less, eyes to the camera or just past it, head tilt a few degrees at most. Chest-up crop ending around the lower ribs, so that both hands are outside the frame. The eye line sits about 27% from the top edge, the top of the hair at least 4% below the top edge, the whole face inside the upper 50% of the frame, broad shoulders and pauldrons spanning about 75% of the width with at least 6% margin at every edge; the lowest third of the frame is plain breastplate and cloak folds.
STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration, detailed face and hair, thin soft plum-black linework slightly heavier on the outer silhouette, soft cel shading on the skin in two to three value steps, painterly gradients on matte cloth, weathered worn dull metal, visible brush grain and paper tooth, no gloss.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: cool slate ambient light (#3B434D family) on the face and armour; one thin warm amber rim light (#D9A441) from behind on the left side of the frame, tracing the hair, the jaw and the pauldron edge so the dark silhouette separates from the background; charcoal steel, ash, a tattered cloak in oxblood (lit mid-tone #6B1E2C, shadow #371C21); restrained low saturation, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black.
TECHNICAL: flat pure #00FF00 background, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, shadow, glow or mist; crisp hard silhouette edges; no green anywhere on the subject, no green reflections or green rim light; the hair outline is made of thick clumped locks with no thin flyaway strands; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters, logos, watermark, border, a second person, a helmet, a raised hood, a crown above the star, a bright red cloak, modern items.
